sentences.en: She designated their table with a wave of the hand.
sentences.zh: 她用手一挥就指明了他们的桌子。

sentences.en: All the seats on this train are designated for nonsmokers.
sentences.zh: 这列火车上的所有座位都指定为非吸烟区。

sentences.en: Thanks, but I shouldn't be drinking. I'm the designated driver.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，但我不能喝酒。我是今晚的代驾司机。

senses.zh: 把……定名为，把……描述为；任命，指定；标明，标示
